title: Addition of binary linear equations
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set, and let $E_1$ and $E_2$ be linear equations over $ br/2 br$ on $V$. Their sum is the equation whose coefficient at each variable is the sum of the corresponding coefficients of $E_1$ and $E_2$, and whose constant term is the sum of their constant terms, all in $ br/2 br$.
